newsitem.title: USA: UAL's United matching Delta fare sale.
newsitem.headline: UAL's United matching Delta fare sale.

text.p: UAL Corp said Monday its United Airlines will match Delta Air Lines Inc's winter fare sale, which includes discounts of up to 40 percent, on routes in which the two carriers compete.
"We're matching where we compete with them," UAL spokesman Joe Hopkins said.
Earlier, Delta said it is offering discounts of up to 40 percent on flights throughout North America, Europe, Asia and the Caribbean.
The fares are good from January 6 through March 15, Delta said. Its offer is good through February 12 to Florida, Hawaii, Bermuda and the Caribbean. Tickets must be purchased by January 13.
Tickets must be purchased at least seven days in advance and a Saturday night stay is required.
